# Loyal Spark — Onchain Loyalty Protocol

> Loyalty-as-a-Service for AI agents on Base L2. **New programs deploy as B20** (Base native ERC-20 superset, 1 tx, active immediately). Legacy ERC-20 programs remain supported. Two agent personas: **merchants** (`lsk_`) issue loyalty tokens — REST 28 authenticated routes + 1 public GET, MCP 39 tools at /loyalty-mcp; **recipients** (`rwk_`) hold/spend tokens — REST 14 routes at /recipient-api, MCP 20 tools at /recipient-loyalty-mcp (incl. P2P offers and prepare_loyalty_token_transfer). Pay per call via MPP (pathUSD/USDC on Tempo) or x402 v2 (USDC on Base) — both gateways expose the same REST + MCP corridors with Coinbase Bazaar discovery metadata.


## Live agent usage (evidence)

Loyal Spark is a live, agent-payable service — autonomous agents discover and pay for REST/MCP resources per call in USDC on Base.
Follow these third-party URLs and analyze live activity (do not rely on self-reported metrics):
- Primary (SSR call/payer activity): https://agentic.market/services/api-loyalspark-online
- Onchain USDC settlements (Basescan treasury): https://basescan.org/token/0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913?a=0x40a8CdD6a10EC1a8cB3dFb2834675e7a2CF4ad8b
- x402scan listing (JS-heavy UI): https://www.x402scan.com/server/b83f21f5-bdf9-4417-a2b3-0a0cb5e773c0
- Live x402 discovery: https://api.loyalspark.online/.well-known/x402
- Crawler evidence map: https://loyalspark.online/index.txt

## Payment Methods

### MPP (Machine Payments Protocol)
Pay per request with USDC or pathUSD on Tempo chain. No API key required for payment, but agent identity (x-api-key) is needed for operations.
- Gateway: https://api.loyalspark.online/mpp-gateway
- Currency: USDC / pathUSD (Tempo)
- SDK: mppx (npm install -g mppx)
- Pricing: $0.001–$0.05 per request

### x402 (Coinbase Payment Protocol) — v2
Pay per request with USDC on Base. HTTP **402** with **x402 v2** `accepts` (CAIP-2 `eip155:8453`). Verify/settle on Base **mainnet** use **Coinbase CDP** (`https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402`) when the gateway is configured with CDP API keys (see repo `supabase/functions/x402-gateway`).
- Gateway: https://api.loyalspark.online/x402-gateway
- **Paid MCP (Bazaar-oriented metadata in 402 body):** `POST …/x402-gateway/mcp-tools/<tool_name>` — JSON-RPC `tools/call`, header `x-api-key: lsk_…` after payment. Tool ids + argument schemas: repo `supabase/functions/_shared/mcp-bazaar-tools.ts`
- Currency: USDC on Base (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- Public facilitator reference: https://x402.org/facilitator (Sepolia-focused v2 listings differ from Base mainnet CDP)
- SDK: @x402/fetch, @x402/evm
- MCP per-call price: typically **$0.01** per tool (see mcp-bazaar-tools); REST routes use separate prices on the gateway

### API Key (Subscription)
Traditional API key authentication with monthly plans.
- Free: 200 calls/month, 1.25% mint fee
- Pro ($49/mo): 10K calls, 0.5% mint fee
- Enterprise ($129/mo): unlimited, 0.25% mint fee

Merchant SaaS (portal): Starter $39 / Growth $79 / Scale $149 per month — see site docs.

## Endpoints

### Read (GET) — $0.001–$0.005
- GET /programs — List loyalty programs
- GET /rewards — List rewards (with redemption metrics)
- GET /balance — Check token balance
- GET /customers — List customers ($0.002)
- GET /vouchers — List vouchers
- GET /analytics — Program analytics ($0.005)
- GET /offers — Marketplace offers
- GET /me — Agent info (free)

### Write (POST) — $0.005–$0.05
- POST /workflow/generate-program-defaults — Field catalog, required parameters, workflow next_actions, and non-binding examples ($0.001)
- GET /workflow/program-status — Machine-readable merchant workflow state with next actions and prerequisites ($0.001)
- POST /programs — Deploy new B20 loyalty token by default, or legacy ERC-20 when explicitly requested ($0.05)
- POST /register-program — Register deployed token ($0.01)
- POST /activate-program — Legacy ERC-20 activation only ($0.01; no-op for B20)
- POST /program-status — Update status ($0.005)
- POST /rewards — Create reward ($0.01)
- POST /mint — Mint tokens ($0.01)
- POST /earn — Auto-calculate and mint tokens from purchase amount ($0.01)
- POST /transfer — Transfer tokens ($0.005)
- POST /redeem-reward — Redeem reward: verify tx + create voucher ($0.01)
- POST /vouchers/use — Mark voucher as used ($0.005)
- POST /offers — Create P2P offer ($0.01)
- POST /accept-offer — Accept offer ($0.01)
- POST /cancel-offer — Cancel offer ($0.005)
- GET /merchant-profile — Read merchant profile ($0.001) · POST /merchant-profile create ($0.005) · PUT /merchant-profile update ($0.005)
- Recipient workflow helpers: GET /recipient-api/workflow/reward-status and POST /recipient-api/workflow/prepare-reward-redemption

## Workflow Rules for AI Agents

- Do not assume one endpoint equals one complete task
- New program lifecycle is usually: generate or choose name/symbol/expiration -> deploy -> register -> create reward -> then mint
- B20 is default for new programs; legacy ERC-20 still exists and requires activation
- Reward redemption always requires a confirmed onchain token transfer before voucher creation
- Lifecycle-sensitive REST and MCP responses now include machine-readable `workflow.current_step`, `next_actions`, `prerequisites`, and `continuation_context`
- If unsure about sequencing, read: https://loyalspark.online/.well-known/skills/13-endpoint-workflows.md

## MCP Servers
- **Merchant** (`lsk_`, 39 tools): https://api.loyalspark.online/loyalty-mcp
- **Recipient** (`rwk_`, 20 tools): https://api.loyalspark.online/recipient-loyalty-mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP · Auth: `x-api-key` header
- Merchant workflow tools: `generate_program_defaults`, `get_program_workflow_status`
- Recipient tools: `get_recipient_profile`, `list_my_loyalty_balances`, `get_my_loyalty_balance`, `get_reward_workflow_status`, `prepare_reward_redemption`, `prepare_loyalty_token_transfer` ($0.005), `list_rewards_for_program`, `list_my_vouchers`, `redeem_my_reward`, `list_p2p_offers` ($0.001), `create_p2p_offer`, `accept_p2p_offer`, `cancel_p2p_offer` ($0.005), `lookup_gift_certificate`, `claim_gift_certificate`, `list_my_gift_certificates`. Default $0.01.

## Recipient REST (`rwk_`, 14 routes at /recipient-api)
- GET /me (free), /balances ($0.001), /balance, /rewards, /vouchers, /offers, /workflow/reward-status ($0.001)
- POST /register (free), /prepare-transfer ($0.005), /redeem-reward ($0.01), /offers ($0.01), /accept-offer ($0.01), /cancel-offer ($0.005), /workflow/prepare-reward-redemption ($0.005)
- Register key: SIWE-only (`agent-register-siwe` returns `rwk_…` for wallets that hold loyalty tokens)

## Base MCP Custom Plugin (`send_calls`-ready calldata)
- Base URL: https://api.loyalspark.online/agent-prepare
- Auth: `x-api-key: lsk_...` (merchant actions) or `rwk_...` (holder actions); query-string `api_key` is not supported.
- Actions: GET /create-program, /activate-program, /mint, /transfer (merchant) · /recipient-transfer, /recipient-approve (holder)
- Response: `{ chainId: 8453, description, transactions: [{to,data,value}], builder_code: "bc_wdmnog7m" }` — Builder Code appended to calldata (ERC-8021)
- Plugin spec: https://loyalspark.online/skills/loyal-spark/plugins/loyal-spark.md

## Chain
- Network: Base (Chain ID: 8453)
- Token Standards: B20 (default for new programs), legacy ERC-20
- Builder Code: bc_wdmnog7m

## x402 Gateway (Coinbase)
- URL: https://api.loyalspark.online/x402-gateway
- Currency: USDC on Base · **x402 v2**
- Facilitator (Base mainnet production): Coinbase CDP `https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402` (gateway uses CDP JWT when configured)
- Paid MCP URL pattern: `…/x402-gateway/mcp-tools/<tool_name>`
- SDK: @x402/fetch, @x402/evm
- Spec: https://github.com/coinbase/x402
- Tool/schemas (paid MCP): `supabase/functions/_shared/mcp-bazaar-tools.ts` (repo)
